pain_and_comfort.laser_hair_removal: Laser hair removal feels like a quick rubber band snap on the skin. Most clients find it very tolerable. We apply a cooling gel before the session to minimise discomfort. Pain level is typically 2–3 out of 10.
pain_and_comfort.botox: Botox injections use a very fine needle and feel like a tiny pinch lasting 1–2 seconds. Most clients find it painless. No anaesthesia is needed.
pain_and_comfort.fillers: Dermal fillers are injected using a fine needle or cannula. A topical numbing cream is applied 20–30 minutes before to minimise discomfort. Most clients rate it 3–4 out of 10.
pain_and_comfort.hydrafacial: HydraFacial is completely painless and non-invasive. It feels like a gentle vacuum massage on the skin. No downtime.
pain_and_comfort.chemical_peel: Chemical peels cause a mild tingling or warm sensation during the treatment. Superficial peels have no downtime. Deeper peels (like TCA) may cause 3–5 days of peeling.
pain_and_comfort.microneedling: Microneedling uses a numbing cream applied 30–45 minutes before the session. During the procedure, most clients feel a mild pressure. Redness for 24–48 hours post-treatment is normal.
pain_and_comfort.prp_gfc: PRP and GFC involve a blood draw (like a routine blood test) and micro-injections. A numbing cream is used. Mild scalp soreness for 24 hours after hair PRP is normal.
pain_and_comfort.fat_freezing: Fat freezing (Cryolipolysis) involves a pulling/suction sensation and intense cold for the first 5–10 minutes, which then goes numb. Most clients read or use their phone during the session. No downtime.

downtime.botox: No downtime. You can resume daily activities immediately. Avoid strenuous exercise, alcohol, and lying flat for 4 hours post-treatment.
downtime.fillers: Minimal downtime. Mild swelling or bruising for 2–5 days is normal. Avoid heat and exercise for 24 hours.
downtime.laser_hair_removal: No downtime. Mild redness for 1–2 hours is normal. Avoid sun exposure and hot showers for 24 hours.
downtime.hydrafacial: Zero downtime. Skin looks instantly refreshed and glowy.
downtime.chemical_peel_superficial: No downtime. Mild dryness for 2–3 days.
downtime.chemical_peel_tca: 3–5 days of visible skin peeling. Plan accordingly before events.
downtime.microneedling: 24–48 hours of redness (like mild sunburn). Avoid makeup for 24 hours.
downtime.fat_freezing: No downtime. Area may feel sore for 2–3 days.

results.botox: Results visible in 3–7 days, full effect at 2 weeks. Lasts 3–6 months depending on the individual.
results.fillers: Results are immediate. Lasts 12–18 months depending on the area and filler used.
results.laser_hair_removal: Each session reduces hair by 15–25%. Significant reduction visible after 3–4 sessions. Near-permanent results after 6–8 sessions.
results.hydrafacial: Skin looks brighter and more hydrated immediately after. Cumulative benefits with monthly sessions.
results.prp_hair: Hair fall reduction noticeable after 3 sessions. New hair growth visible around 3–6 months.
results.fat_freezing: Fat reduction visible in 4–12 weeks as the body naturally eliminates frozen fat cells. Best results after 2–3 sessions.

sessions_needed.laser_hair_removal: 6–8 sessions for permanent hair reduction, spaced 4–6 weeks apart.
sessions_needed.botox: Single session, repeated every 3–6 months to maintain results.
sessions_needed.fillers: Single session per area. Top-up at 12–18 months.
sessions_needed.hydrafacial: One session gives instant results. Monthly sessions recommended for best skin health.
sessions_needed.chemical_peel: 3–6 sessions depending on the concern (acne scars, pigmentation).
sessions_needed.prp_hair: 4 sessions, 1 month apart, then maintenance every 6 months.
sessions_needed.fat_freezing: 1–3 sessions per area depending on fat volume.

preparation.laser_hair_removal: Shave the area 24 hours before. Avoid waxing or threading for 4 weeks before. No sun exposure or tanning for 2 weeks before.
preparation.botox_fillers: Avoid blood thinners (aspirin, alcohol) for 3–5 days before. Come with a clean face.
preparation.hydrafacial: No special preparation needed. Avoid retinol for 48 hours before.
preparation.chemical_peel: Stop retinol and AHAs for 5–7 days before. Use SPF daily in the weeks leading up.
